## About
Houston A/C Compressor Inc. is a small manufacturer on S Breeze Dr in southwest Houston. We rebuild automotive A/C compressors for import and domestic vehicles, and we sell them along with hose sets and full A/C repair and replacement.
Each compressor is inspected, tested and remanufactured by our staff, rebuilt to factory specifications and checked for leaks and pressure. We keep a large inventory so we can usually get you what you need without a long wait.
When it's hot outside, you want it cool inside your car. We hold a 4.3 rating from 51 Google reviews. Ask us about this month's specials.

## Services
- Remanufactured A/C compressors: Top quality remanufactured automotive A/C compressors, ready to install in your car.
- Rebuilt compressors: Each rebuilt compressor is individually inspected, tested and remanufactured by our trained staff.
- Auto A/C repair and service: Air conditioning repair and service for your car, right here in Houston.

## FAQ
Q: Do you work on foreign cars?
A: Yes. We handle A/C compressors for all car makes and models, both foreign and domestic.

Q: Do your compressors come with a warranty?
A: Our remanufactured compressors are sold with clutches and come with a limited factory warranty. Call us for the details.

Q: How quickly can I get a compressor?
A: We keep a large inventory, which lets us meet most requests in a single business day.
